description:
[Inventory] Does this account likely have Rust Premium Access? (estimate). Premium servers (`server.premium true`) only admit accounts Facepunch marks premium: an inventory worth at least
`required_value` (1500 = $15, the game's own text). This values the account's Rust skins at the wiki price (Steam
lowest sell order) and compares. `qualifies_estimate` is true/false (null when the inventory is private or empty);
`status` is likely, borderline_above, borderline_below, unlikely or unknown - values within $12-$18 are borderline
because Facepunch's prices are unknown. `shortfall` is the cents still needed; `suggestions.one_skin` are the cheapest
liquid skins that close it alone, `suggestions.cheapest` the cheapest liquid skins overall (`suggestions.updating` true:
the hourly list is being rebuilt, both lists empty - ask again later). An ESTIMATE: Facepunch
doesn't publish its valuation. Same lookup and caching as /inventory/{steamid} (stored copy for 24 h). Use for 'can I join Premium servers' / 'do I have Premium Access': values the account's Rust skins against the $15 minimum. It is an ESTIMATE - say so; Facepunch's valuation is unknown. Takes a SteamID64 (resolve_steam_profile first). Same stored lookup as get_inventory. Link page.

steamid.description: 17-digit SteamID64 (resolve URLs and vanity names with /players/resolve).

name: check_premium_access
title: Does this account likely have Rust Premium Access? (estimate)
